SELECT SELLER_ID, SELLER_NAME, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, USER_NAME, TELEPHONE_NUMBER, PHONE_NUMBER, FAX_NUMBER, EMAIL, POST, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DETAIL,
SECOND_USER_NAME, SECOND_TELEPHONE_NUMBER, SECOND_PHONE_NUMBER, SECOND_EMAIL,
COMPANY_NAME, REPRESENTATIVE_NAME, BUSINESS_NUMBER, BUSINESS_LOCATION, BUSINESS_TYPE, BUSINESS_ITEMS, COMMISSION_RATE, BANK_NAME, BANK_IN_NAME, BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, STATUS_CODE, CREATED_DATE FROM OP_SELLER

SELECT
S.SELLER_ID, S.SELLER_NAME, S.LOGIN_ID
S.SELLER_ID, S.SELLER_NAME, S.LOGIN_ID, S.PASSWORD, S.USER_NAME, S.TELEPHONE_NUMBER, S.PHONE_NUMBER, S.FAX_NUMBER, S.EMAIL, S.POST, S.ADDRESS, S.ADDRESS_DETAIL, S.ITEM_APPROVAL_TYPE, S.SECOND_USER_NAME, S.SECOND_TELEPHONE_NUMBER, S.SECOND_PHONE_NUMBER, S.SECOND_EMAIL, S.COMPANY_NAME, S.REPRESENTATIVE_NAME, S.BUSINESS_NUMBER, S.BUSINESS_LOCATION, S.BUSINESS_TYPE, S.BUSINESS_ITEMS, S.COMMISSION_RATE, S.BANK_NAME, S.BANK_IN_NAME, S.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, ( SELECT CONCAT(LOCGOV.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, ' ', LOCGOV.LOCGOV_NM) FROM G_LOCGOV LOCGOV WHERE LOCGOV.LOCGOV_CODE = S.LOCGOV_CODE ) AS LOCGOV_NM, CASE WHEN SU.mber_dn IS NULL OR SU.mber_dn = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS MBER_DN, CASE WHEN SU.mber_fin_dn IS NULL OR SU.mber_fin_dn = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS MBER_FIN_DN, CASE WHEN SU.mber_ci IS NULL OR SU.mber_ci = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS MBER_CI, S.STATUS_CODE, S.CREATED_DATE
FROM OP_SELLER S inner join OP_SELLER_USER SU on s.login_id = su.login_id
AND S.STATUS_CODE = #{statusCode}
AND S.SELLER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query} , '%')
AND S.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query} , '%')
AND S.COMPANY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query} , '%')
AND S.LOGIN_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query} , '%')
AND S.REPRESENTATIVE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query} , '%')
AND S.PHONE_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query} , '%')
AND S.SELLER_ID != #{defaultOpmanagerSellerId}
AND S.CREATED_DATE >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, '000000')
AND S.CREATED_DATE <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, '235959')
AND S.ITEM_APPROVAL_TYPE = #{itemApprovalType}
AND S.LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgov}
ORDER BY S.CREATED_DATE DESC

SELECT S.* , (SELECT UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || LOCGOV_NM FROM G_LOCGOV WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = S.LOCGOV_CODE) AS LOCGOV_NM , SUBSTR(S.EMAIL, 0, INSTR(S.EMAIL, '@')-1) AS EMAIL_BEFORE , SUBSTR(S.EMAIL, INSTR(S.EMAIL, '@')+1) AS EMAIL_AFTER
, SU.USER_ID , CASE WHEN SU.MBER_CI IS NULL OR SU.MBER_CI = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS MBER_CI , SU.RECEIVE_SMS FROM OP_SELLER S , OP_SELLER_USER SU WHERE S.SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} AND SU.LOGIN_ID = S.LOGIN_ID
SELECT RPAD(#{locgovNm}, 10, LPAD(COUNT(*)+#{plusSeq}, 5, '0')) FROM OP_SELLER_USER WHERE LOGIN_ID LIKE CONCAT(#{locgovNm}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OP_SELLER (SELLER_ID, SELLER_NAME, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, USER_NAME, TELEPHONE_NUMBER, PHONE_NUMBER, FAX_NUMBER, EMAIL, POST, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DETAIL, SECOND_USER_NAME, SECOND_TELEPHONE_NUMBER, SECOND_PHONE_NUMBER, SECOND_EMAIL, COMPANY_NAME, REPRESENTATIVE_NAME, BUSINESS_NUMBER, BUSINESS_LOCATION, BUSINESS_TYPE, BUSINESS_ITEMS, COMMISSION_RATE, REMITTANCE_TYPE, REMITTANCE_DAY, BANK_NAME, BANK_IN_NAME, BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, SHIPPING_FLAG, SHIPPING, SHIPPING_FREE_AMOUNT, SHIPPING_EXTRA_CHARGE1, SHIPPING_EXTRA_CHARGE2, ITEM_APPROVAL_TYPE, SMS_SEND_TIME, MD_ID, MD_NAME, STATUS_CODE, CREATED_DATE, CREATED_USER_ID, UPDATED_DATE, UPDATED_USER_ID, MAIL_ORDER_NUMBER, BUY_SAFETY_USE_CONFIRM_NUMBER, TAX_TYPE, FILE_NAME_CERTIFICATE1, FILE_NAME_CERTIFICATE2, FILE_NAME_CERTIFICATE3, LOCGOV_CODE, ADULT_ITEM_YN, COMMUNITY_BUSINESS_YN) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{sellerName}, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{userName}, #{telephoneNumber}, #{phoneNumber}, #{faxNumber}, #{email}, #{post}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{secondUserName}, #{secondTelephoneNumber}, #{secondPhoneNumber}, #{secondEmail}, #{companyName}, #{representativeName}, #{businessNumber}, #{businessLocation}, #{businessType}, #{businessItems}, #{commissionRate}, #{remittanceType}, #{remittanceDay}, #{bankName}, #{bankInName}, #{bankAccountNumber}, #{shippingFlag}, #{shipping}, #{shippingFreeAmount}, #{shippingExtraCharge1}, #{shippingExtraCharge2}, #{itemApprovalType}, #{smsSendTime}, #{mdId}, #{mdName}, #{statusCode}, , #{createdUserId}, , #{updatedUserId}, #{mailOrderNumber}, #{buySafetyUseConfirmNumber}, #{taxType}, #{fileNameCertificate1}, #{fileNameCertificate2}, #{fileNameCertificate3}, #{locgovCode}, #{adultItemYn}, #{communityBusinessYn})

mapper.select: SELECT C1.CATEGORY_ID, C1.CATEGORY_CLASS1 AS CATEGORY_CLASS, C1.CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM OP_SELLER S INNER JOIN OP_ITEM I ON S.SELLER_ID = I.SELLER_ID AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2' AND I.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' INNER JOIN OP_ITEM_CATEGORY IC ON I.ITEM_ID = IC.ITEM_ID INNER JOIN OP_CATEGORY C ON IC.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID AND C.CATEGORY_FLAG = 'Y' INNER JOIN OP_CATEGORY C1 ON C.CATEGORY_CLASS1 = C1.CATEGORY_CLASS1 AND C1.CATEGORY_LEVEL = '1' AND C1.CATEGORY_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE S.SELLER_ID = #{value} GROUP BY C1.CATEGORY_ID, C1.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY C1.CATEGORY_NAME

SELECT T_A.* , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', T_A.MBER_CI_ENC, '', 0) AS MBER_CI , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', T_A.PHONE_NUMBER_ENC, '', 0) AS PHONE_NUMBER FROM ( SELECT U.USER_ID , S.COMPANY_NAME
, U.MBER_CI AS MBER_CI_ENC , U.RECEIVE_SMS
